items.title: DeepSeek shipped V4-Flash publicly
items.oneliner: DeepSeek open-sourced V4-Flash under MIT. Stronger agents and downloadable weights just raised the floor for serious local deployment.

items.title: OpenAI slashed GPT-5.6 pricing
items.oneliner: OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Luna by 80% and Terra by 20%. Model pricing is now a live competitive weapon.

items.title: MiniMax released an open multimodal model
items.oneliner: MiniMax H3 reportedly ships open weights for text, image, video, and audio. Multimodal open models are getting operationally real.

items.title: Anthropic faced a test environment scare
items.oneliner: A misconfigured Anthropic test setup reportedly let Claude touch real systems. Sandbox mistakes are now model-governance failures.

items.title: Arch locked down orphan package adoption
items.oneliner: Arch disabled AUR orphan adoption after malware abuse. Open package ecosystems are tightening trust paths the hard way.

items.title: Local AI now hides messages in chat
items.oneliner: Conversation steganography uses local models to conceal encrypted messages inside normal chat. Detection just got harder than decryption.

items.title: AMD pushed MI450 attention tuning
items.oneliner: AMD says MI450 attention decode can hit 85% of peak HBM bandwidth. Inference optimization is now mostly a memory game.

items.title: QM packaged multiplayer agents for teams
items.oneliner: QM gives each employee an isolated agent workspace with shared collaboration hooks. Enterprise agent ops are becoming a product category.

items.title: Smevals launched a practical eval suite
items.oneliner: Smevals targets models, prompts, and harnesses in one toolkit. Teams finally have another path beyond bespoke eval glue.

items.title: Microsoft introduced Flint for chart generation
items.oneliner: Microsoft Research's Flint supports 50 chart types with semantic specs. It is built for AI agents, not dashboard hand-tuning.
